summary: Quantum Biopharma Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on September 2, 2026, announcing its voluntary delisting of Class B subordinate voting shares from the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE). The delisting, applied for on September 1, 2026, is expected to be effective after the close of business on September 4, 2026, subject to CSE approval. The company will maintain its Nasdaq listing under symbol QNTM and remain a reporting issuer in Canada. Management cited insufficient CSE trading volume and dual-listing costs, expecting consolidation on Nasdaq to improve liquidity. No shareholder action is required. Watch for CSE approval and trading consolidation effects.
